name: Google Sheets (read-only)
description: Google Sheets, read-only (scope spreadsheets.readonly): spreadsheets.get and values.get / values:batchGet by spreadsheet ID. Cannot edit. Sheets has no ID-free read call, so test_connection only mints a token. Auth: drawlatch mints short-lived access tokens from GOOGLE_OAUTH_CLIENT_ID, GOOGLE_OAUTH_CLIENT_SECRET and GOOGLE_OAUTH_REFRESH_TOKEN (user OAuth; the agent never sees them) and refuses any token broader than this scope. See CONNECTIONS.md "Google (scoped)".
